source.authority: Derived snapshot only; task files own dependency edges, QUEUE.md owns phases and status, ACTIVE.md owns claims.
source.graph_scope: Open and complete tasks only. Superseded and deferred tasks retain metadata and historical_dependencies but have no current phase or scheduling edges.

definitions.root_task: A current task with no recorded hard dependencies.
definitions.terminal_task: A current task with no direct dependents.
definitions.dependency_component: A weakly connected current group when edge direction is ignored.
definitions.large_dependency_branch: At least 10 transitive dependents; scheduling impact, not implementation scope.
definitions.completed_edges: Completed prerequisites remain recorded; later caller migrations are follow-ups, not retroactive hard dependencies.
definitions.inactive_task: A superseded or deferred task excluded from current graph metrics.
